verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas does not document a built-in AI assistant inside the Editor. It does ship official AI tooling: an official Editor MCP server that lets external AI assistants modify project data and verify results in an open Editor session, plus PlayCanvas Skills that give compatible coding agents PlayCanvas-specific workflows. You therefore get assistant-driven script and scene work only by bringing your own third-party agent. missing for 10: a first-party in-editor assistant, documented API question-answering or script generation inside the engine, asset scaffolding by an assistant, and independent hands-on corroboration.
